SMTO-SKL-0126 — That Slack channel is archived

GUID: 92af4447-48ba-56a7-a08f-8fa57e32de2e
Slug: slack-channel-archived
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • The channel you asked about has been archived in Slack, so Slack won't accept this request there. Nothing was posted or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the Agent to list your Slack conversations and choose an active channel instead. Archived channels are read-only in Slack, so the request needs a channel that's still in use.
  2. If you need this exact channel, ask its owner or your Slack workspace admin to unarchive it in Slack. SMTO never unarchives channels for you.
  3. Then ask the Agent for your request again. Slack refused it without making changes, so it's safe to repeat.

What success looks like

  • The request completes in an active channel.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the channel name, to your Slack workspace admin.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Slack returned is_archived: the target conversation is archived and rejects this operation.

What this means

  • Slack returns is_archived for the requested channel operation. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Slack returns is_archived for the requested channel operation.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the exact channel's archived state.

How to fix it

  • Select an active channel_id via slack.conversations, or have a workspace member unarchive the channel in Slack; the skill has no unarchive operation and never unarchives implicitly.
  • Select an accessible active channel. This skill does not unarchive channels.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • The deliberate operation uses an accessible active channel without unarchiving implicitly.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
